question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**words**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**​

__
 
• "**Words**" **(****शब्द****)** fits well as it denotes a basic unit of language, which aligns with the context of the sentence structure.
 
• The context tells us that the British conquest of Sindh is typically strongly denounced by historians.
 
• Other options ("**letter**", "**poetry**", "**paragraph**") do not fit the context of describing the basic unit of language in this specific sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Historians generally condemn the acquisition of Sindh by the British in strong words__. The causes for annexation were deliberately manufactured. Like many episodes in the British conquest of India, the Afghan war is also a tale of bullying tactics and deceit. However, in the instance of the First Afghan War, the English suffered terribly at the hands of the Afghans with a corresponding loss of prestige.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Letter (पत्र): **"Letter" refers to a character representing one or more of the sounds used in speech.
 
• **Poetry (कविता): **"Poetry" is a form of literature that uses aesthetic and rhythmic qualities of language.
 
• **Paragraph (अनुच्छेद):** "Paragraph" is a distinct section of a piece of writing.
